## Canonical CSV import

Parses the raw official Xero Uncoded Statement Lines CSV in n8n, fails closed on malformed or oversized data, preserves every exported bank-account label, and starts a read-only review. The request records that All bank accounts was requested; it is not treated as proof of full organisation coverage.

const parsed=$('Parse Official CSV').first().json;const verified=$('Verify Export Organisation').first().json;const provenance={sessionId:String(parsed.sessionId||''),captureRunId:String(parsed.runId||''),captureTenantId:String(verified.tenantId||''),captureOrganisationName:String(verified.organisationName||'')};return parsed.scans.map(scan=>({json:{...scan,...provenance}}));

const parsed=$('Parse Official CSV').first().json;const verified=$('Verify Export Organisation').first().json;const lines=parsed.lines;if(!lines.length)return [{json:{hasLines:false}}];const provenance={sessionId:String(parsed.sessionId||''),captureRunId:String(parsed.runId||''),captureTenantId:String(verified.tenantId||''),captureOrganisationName:String(verified.organisationName||'')};return lines.map(line=>{const visible=(()=>{try{return JSON.parse(String(line.visibleFieldsJson||'{}'));}catch{return{};}})();return {json:{hasLines:true,...provenance,lineKey:line.lineKey,statementLineId:line.statementLineId,scanId:line.scanId,bankAccountId:line.bankAccountId,active:line.active,occurredAt:line.date,narration:line.narration,reference:line.reference,direction:line.direction,amount:line.amount,currency:line.currency,visibleContact:line.payee,visibleAccount:'',visibleDescription:String(visible.particulars||line.narration||''),visibleTaxType:'',visibleEventName:'',visibleProjectName:'',visibleFieldsJson:line.visibleFieldsJson,uiMode:'uncoded_export',matchedXeroTransactionId:'',sourceHash:line.sourceHash,capturedAt:line.capturedAt}};});
